beliefs: The box shifts each character forward by 8 codepoints, applied independently per character [E1, E2, E3, E6, E8]
The shift applies uniformly across ASCII, Latin-1, and multi-byte ranges including surrogates and near U+10FFFF [E6, E8]
A character 't' (0x74) is deleted (maps to empty string) rather than shifted, regardless of context [E13, E14]
A character '|' (0x7C) maps to '(' (0x28) only when it is the first character or immediately follows a space; otherwise it shifts to 0x84 [E12, E13, E14]
All other characters including '~' (0x7E -> 0x86) follow the uniform +8 rule [E7, E9, E10, E11]
notes: E14 shows 't' always deletes (never maps to '('), while '|' keeps its first-or-after-space -> '(' rule; the previous model wrongly applied the '(' rule to 't'.
